rows.title: INS page titles follow the GOV.UK title pattern
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 uses one browser title pattern on every page. The INS frontend's titles change from '<page title> | Import notification service' to '<page title> - Import notification service - GOV.UK', as the animals frontend's already read. It is one change to the INS frontend's shared layout, so every INS page picks it up at once.
acceptanceCriteria: On the INS frontend, every page's browser title reads the page's title, then 'Import notification service', then 'GOV.UK', joined by ' - ' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p1-086; repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p4-001; conflicts:c-146)

On an INS frontend page shown with validation errors, the browser title reads 'Error: ' followed by the same pattern, such as 'Error: <page title> - Import notification service - GOV.UK' (repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p4-001; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p1-086)
No INS frontend page's browser title contains ' | Import notification service' any more (trace:e2e trace-e2e-p15-004; repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p4-001)
rows.notes: One thin slice: req-1686 is the only new or changed requirement in this area; every other adopted requirement here is already met (exists) and goes to the report. The title pattern lives in the INS frontend's shared layout, so other areas' INS rows (dashboard home, address book) assert the new pattern on their own pages rather than change it. c-146 settles the dashboard's own title as 'Dashboard - Import notification service - GOV.UK', which this pattern produces. The 'Error: ' prefix is kept from today's layout.
